description: Use this when the user asks whether AI answers name their launched product. A claimed launch's free AI answers (tier owner or verified; an unclaimed launch can save questions but not run them): up to 5 questions someone who needs the product would ask (never naming it), asked on ChatGPT, Google AI Mode and AI Overviews. Pass questions to replace them; run: true starts the first check, once per launch (each question 3 times on every engine), asked as from country (US unless given). Claimed founding launches are then asked again every day until their period ends. Returns the questions and the results so far: how often the product is named and who is named instead, per question. With raw: true it also returns the latest day's answers themselves: each engine's text (up to 1500 characters), whether and where it named the product, who else it named, and the pages it cited. Answers arrive within a few hours.

country.description: With run: the country the answers are asked from, kept for the daily runs; usually where the maker's buyers are. Defaults to US.

raw.description: Include the latest day's answers: text, names, cited pages.

run.description: Start the first check (once per launch).

name: launch_ai_answers
title: A launch's free AI answers
